_note: Draft English of Saadia's JA Tafsir on Bereshit 34 (Dinah and Shechem). Saadia-specific: v.7 'כ'סאסה' = 'an outrage/disgrace' for נבלה; v.30 'רהט ד'ו אחצא' = 'a small clan of countable [members]' (Saadia's gloss for מתי מספר); v.31 'אכזאניה' = 'as one who treats [his sister] as a prostitute' (Saadia explicit gloss).

translations.1: Then Dinah, daughter of Leah, whom she had borne to Jacob, went out to look at the daughters of the people of the land.
translations.2: And Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the noble of the land, saw her; and he took her, and lay with her, and forced her.
translations.3: And his soul clung to her; and he loved her, and spoke kindly with her.
translations.4: And he said to Hamor his father: 'Take for me this maiden as a wife.'
translations.5: And Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah his daughter; and his sons were with his cattle in the wilderness; and he held his peace until their coming.
translations.6: And Hamor, father of Shechem, went out to Jacob, to speak with him about it.
translations.7: And the sons of Jacob came from the wilderness when they heard; and the men were grieved, and it grew very hard upon them — for he had wrought an outrage against Israel, by lying with his daughter; and so should not be done.
translations.8: And Hamor spoke with them, saying: 'My son Shechem — his soul is attached to your daughter; give her to him as a wife.
translations.9: And intermarry with us — give us your daughters, and take our daughters.
translations.10: And dwell with us; behold, the land is before you; settle, and trade in it, and possess it.'
translations.11: And Shechem also said to her father and her brothers: 'Let me find favor with you; and whatever you say to me, I shall give.
translations.12: Increase upon me greatly bride-price and gift; and I shall give as you say to me — only give me this maiden as a wife.'
translations.13: And the sons of Jacob answered them with cunning, saying — for he had defiled Dinah their sister —
translations.14: and they said to them: 'We cannot do this thing — to give our sister to a man who has a foreskin; for that is a disgrace to us.
translations.15: But on this condition shall we consent to you: that you become as we are — that every male among you be circumcised.
translations.16: Then we shall give you our daughters, and take your daughters; and we shall dwell with you, and become one people.
translations.17: But if you shall not accept from us, and be circumcised — we shall take our daughter and go.'
translations.18: And their words were pleasing in the eyes of Hamor and of Shechem his son.
translations.19: And the youth did not delay to do the thing — for he desired Jacob's daughter; and he was the most honored of all his father's house.
translations.20: And Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their town, and addressed its dwellers, saying:
translations.21: 'These people are at peace with us — let them dwell in the land and trade in it; behold, the land is wide enough before them. Let us take their daughters as wives, and give them our daughters.
translations.22: But on this condition will the people consent to dwell with us, and to become one people: that every male of ours be circumcised, as they are circumcised.
translations.23: Their livestock and their cattle and their beasts and the rest of their property — shall it not become ours? Only let us consent to them on this — and they shall dwell with us.'
translations.24: And all who went out of the gate of his town accepted from Hamor and from Shechem his son; and every male of them was circumcised.
translations.25: And on the third day, while they were in pain — Simeon and Levi, Dinah's brothers, each took his sword; and they came upon them while they were unaware, and killed every male.
translations.26: And Hamor and Shechem his son they killed by the edge of the sword; and they took Dinah from the house of Shechem, and went out.
translations.27: The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and plundered what was in the town — because they had defiled their sister.
translations.28: And their flocks, and their cattle, and their donkeys, and what was in the town, and what was in the fields, they took.
translations.29: And all their property, and their little ones, and their wives — they took captive, and plundered, and all that was in the houses.
translations.30: Then Jacob said to Simeon and to Levi: 'You have brought disgrace upon me, and corrupted my standing with the dwellers of the land — the Canaanites and the Perizzites. And I am a small clan of countable [number]; they shall gather against me and kill me, and I and my household shall perish.'
translations.31: They said: 'Shall he treat our sister as a prostitute?'
